# A package with a nested module, an inlined helper and a Base callee that calls back into it.
module Nested
    struct Hidden
        held::Any
    end
    const TALLY = Ref(0)
    @noinline deep(x)::Int = (TALLY[] += 1; length(x))
end
struct Cell
    held::Vector{Int}
end
helper(x) = (x[1] = 1; nothing)
outer(x) = helper(x)
reaches_nested(x) = Nested.deep(x)
@noinline Base.length(cell::Cell) = length(cell.held)
lengths(cells) = map(length, cells)
